$schema_note: Three-act (early/mid/late) wave curve (task-102), a NEW PROPOSAL replacing the shipped Spike1GameMode.h flat wave shape (WaveBroodCounts {250,450,700}, single StartingRetinue/RetinueCap 120) and superseding SYSTEMS.md line 45's locked 250/450/700 curve -- see docs/design/wave-scaling-three-act.md's 'Canon proposals' section for the exact supersession statement. Retinue size now varies per wave (unlike the old curve, which held it flat at 120) and enemy composition unlocks new entity-tiers.json tiers at wave 2 rather than wave 1. Decisions + rationale: docs/design/wave-scaling-three-act.md. Columns/units/ranges: wave-scaling.schema.md. All values PROTOTYPE DIALS / a fresh proposal, unmeasured in-engine except where explicitly citing GATE1-FUN-PROTOTYPE.md's measured baseline or one-camera-bench.md's measured perf ceiling.

design_constants.ceiling_60fps_simlod_stride4_note: UNVERIFIED, CORRECTED 2026-07-31 -- do NOT cite this number as measured fact. It comes from ONE standalone run (one-camera-bench.md §8 run5: 30,000 -> 14.73ms, 40,000 -> 19.06ms/52fps) that four in-editor sweeps on 2026-07-30/31 (task126/128/129/130) did not reproduce -- they cross 16.6ms somewhere between ~13,000 and ~26,000 entities (20k measured at 20.15 / 21.21 / 18.16 / 13.70ms). The gap is confounded (standalone vs. in-editor, +/-0.9ms harness floor, gpu_ms varying 2-6x between identical passes) but UNRESOLVED. Honest working figure: ~13,000-20,000 total entities at 60fps. task-108 replaces this with a measurement. Every HeadroomPctVs34kCeiling value below divides by this untrusted number and is therefore arithmetic, not a measurement -- wave3_late's 39.41 in particular has never been run. This is a TOTAL Mass-Entity figure (retinue + enemy brood share the same sim pass); Elite/Titan/Boss are PromotedActors (entity-tiers.json ActorType) and are NOT part of this budget, and their cost at horde concurrency is entirely unmeasured.
design_constants.ceiling_60fps_no_lod_note: one-camera-bench.md §5/§6 -- the ceiling WITHOUT Swarm.SimLOD.Stride 4 (which is the shipped default, per §7 of that doc). Stated because the late wave's headroom against the 34k figure collapses to ~2% against this lower figure -- the design below depends on SimLOD staying on.
design_constants.gate1_calibration_note: GATE1-FUN-PROTOTYPE.md §3b 'shipped now' measured zero-input baseline, retinue flat-refilled to 120. Used the same way scaling-curve.json's design_constants already use it: as a DIRECTIONAL ratio-collapse reference (docs/sim/LIMITATIONS.md §1 -- never a survivor-count prediction for the waves below, which sit at very different retinue counts than this calibration's fixed N=120).
design_constants.blood_particle_note: docs/perf/blood-particles.md: cost is bounded by Blood.MaxBurstsPerFrame (12), not by population size -- measured +0.7ms FrameTime / +1.4ms GameThreadTime at 820 total live entities under heavy mobbing (peak mobbed 14-15, the cap already saturating). Not re-measured at this doc's larger wave populations; the cap mechanism is the argument it won't grow past that already-measured figure, not a new measurement.
design_constants.unit_types_growth_source_weight_note: unit-types.json types.spearmen.growth_source_weight 0.8 / types.archers.growth_source_weight 0.2 -- the 80/20 split used for every retinue_composition row below that includes Archers, cited rather than invented.
design_constants.surround_cap_handoff_note: scaling-curve.md §6 flags entity-tiers.json's SurroundCapEstimate finding (melee DPS vs. a point-target caps and stops scaling past it) forward 'to whoever tunes growth_source_weight next, if a longer/co-op run ever pushes army size past ~120' -- wave3_late's RetinueStart (600) is exactly that scenario, well past the ~120-250 range task-002's own sweep tested. Flagged in the design doc's Open section, not resolved here.

wave_definitions.Name: wave1_early
wave_definitions.Label: Early
wave_definitions.Notes: Melee-only both sides -- no Archers, no ranged brood, no Elite. STALE, CORRECTED 2026-07-31: this row originally argued 'RetinueStart 60 exactly equals economy.json supply.start_capacity (60): upkeep demand == capacity, no degrade multiplier triggers at wave 1.' task-101 moved start_capacity to 120 on the same day this file was written, so the equality is false and the no-degrade-at-wave-1 argument no longer holds as written -- 60 demand against 120 capacity still does not degrade (demand < capacity), so the CONCLUSION survives, but not the reasoning. Population/army ratio 2.0 sits just under the GATE1 250/120=2.08 'comfortable win' calibration point.

wave_definitions.Name: wave2_mid
wave_definitions.Label: Mid
wave_definitions.Notes: Retinue returns to today's shipped flat number (120) but its INTERNAL composition changes -- Archers now exist. Enemy side unlocks Soldier-melee, Soldier-ranged, and the first Elite, all simultaneously. Ratio 3.333 sits between the GATE1 2.08 (wins) and 3.75 (wipes) calibration points -- the escalating middle, read directionally, not predictively.

wave_definitions.Name: wave3_late
wave_definitions.Label: Late
wave_definitions.RetinueMechanism: growth_site_purchase (exceeds what economy.json's current simulated scenarios reach -- see doc §1 flag)
wave_definitions.Notes: The 'as far as the engine can be pushed' wave. Ratio 33.3 is far outside the 3-point GATE1 calibration band (2.08-5.83) -- argued from the perf ceiling and Design Law 3 composition, NOT from the ratio-collapse model, which was never calibrated at this scale. Headroom vs. the no-LOD 21,000 ceiling is only ~2% -- this design REQUIRES Swarm.SimLOD.Stride 4 (already the shipped default).
